key_facts: Dyspnea on exertion for the past year
Syncope during a bicycle ride with loss of consciousness
Elevated blood pressure of 150/78 mm Hg
Normal breath and heart sounds without murmurs
Normal hemogram, serum electrolytes, and thyroid function test

raw.rationale: The patient's ECG findings show first-degree atrioventricular block and third-degree AV block, which are consistent with atrioventricular block. The patient's symptoms of dyspnea on exertion and syncope can be explained by the AV block, which can lead to reduced cardiac output and decreased blood flow to the brain and other organs.

rejected.label: Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: Normal left ventricular ejection fraction and wall motion, and no significant valvular abnormality

rejected.label: Pulmonary Embolism
rejected.why: No evidence of acute right ventricular strain or other signs of pulmonary embolism

rejected.label: Arrhythmia
rejected.why: No atrial or ventricular arrhythmia found on 24-hour ECG monitoring
